description: Returns CFPB mortgage complaint counts for one lender by year. The result covers complaints about applying or closing and complaints about servicing. It returns a rate per 1,000 applications only when the minimums are met. The result appears only when the company is tied to the lender.

lender.description: The lender's LEI (20 characters) or its page slug.
